history.summary: A freehold 1,023sqft 3BR at $1.698M / $1,660 PSF near Dakota MRT (D14), trading just above the $1,634 URA median on a solid 6.71% CAGR over 43 transactions. Freehold tenure plus a strong 6.71% data-backed rate is appealing, though the low 438 score_1000 and a tight 1,023sqft 3BR layout temper it.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold in D14 (Paya Lebar Central / airbase-relocation catalyst zone) with a credible, well-sampled 6.71%/yr URA CAGR (43 txns) and pricing right at median is a genuinely good combination — freehold removes lease-decay risk and the appreciation track record is real.
